All done! Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Files Created/Modified

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `Models/TicketData.cs` | ML.NET input/output data classes |
| `Models/TicketRequest.cs` | API DTOs (request, prediction response, evaluation response) |

| `Controllers/TicketController.cs` | REST endpoints |
| `Program.cs` | DI registration + JSON config |
| `TicketClassifier.csproj` | Added `Microsoft.ML` package |

### Endpoints

- **`POST /api/ticket/predict`** — Classifies a ticket with confidence scores per category
- **`GET /api/ticket/evaluate`** — Returns micro/macro accuracy, log-loss, and per-category precision/recall/F1

### Verified Results

```
POST predict → { "predictedCategory": "Billing", confidence: 88.9% }
GET evaluate  → { microAccuracy: 1.0, macroAccuracy: 1.0, ... }
```

The model trains at startup using SDCA Maximum Entropy with featurized Subject/Description text and Priority as input features.
